title: EU Checkout Latency & Retry Storm Leak vs. tax-service v4.2.0 Deploy Red Herring
symptom_summary: EU checkout latency spiked above 5000ms with high failure rates starting 2026-10-24T18:12:00Z. Engineers suspect tax-service v4.2.0 (deployed at 17:55 UTC) or the new_tax_engine feature flag rollout.

red_herrings.description: Feature flag new_tax_engine ramped to 20% at 2026-10-24T18:25:00Z
red_herrings.why_plausible: Ramped during the EU tax-service incident window
red_herrings.why_falsified: Temporal precedence violation: 504 timeouts began at 18:12:00Z (13 minutes before flg-505)

red_herrings.why_plausible: Shipped 17 minutes before the latency spike
red_herrings.why_falsified: Cohort isolation check: US-East-1 running identical tax-service v4.2.0 had 0.00% 504 timeouts; failure isolated 100% to upstream provider taxly-eu in eu-west-1

ground_truth_root_cause.description: External tax provider taxly-eu HTTP 504 gateway timeouts in eu-west-1 (18:12–20:05 UTC)
ground_truth_root_cause.mechanism: Upstream taxly-eu degradation caused 5,100–8,900ms timeouts and 3x retry amplification per checkout correlation_id
